appDescription: An automatic vehicle logbook for shared company cars that records each trip, its driver, and its business purpose from vehicle data.

function.name: RECORD_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Records the purpose of the current or most recent trip in the vehicle logbook, optionally with a short note about the work done on the trip.

purpose.description: Purpose of the trip as defined by the logbook.

workNote.description: Short note describing the work done during the trip.

function.name: SET_DRIVER
function.description: Sets who is driving this shared company car so that the logbook records the driver and the car applies the driver's saved climate, seat heating, and ambient light settings.

driverName.description: Name of the driver registered by the company.

function.name: GET_DRIVING_SUMMARY
function.description: Returns the total distance, business-use distance, and business-use ratio recorded in the vehicle logbook for a period.
